# DonorDrive triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to your DonorDrive page (Extra Life and similar charity events). Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `donordrive.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to your DonorDrive page. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `donordrive.disconnected`</small>

## Donation

Runs when someone donates on your DonorDrive fundraising page, such as Extra Life. Great for a thank-you.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The donor's name ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | The message the donor wrote |
| `%recipientName%` | Who the donation was for |
| `%profileName%` | Your fundraising page name |
| `%raised%` | Total raised so far |
| `%goal%` | Your goal |
| `%formattedRaised%` | Total raised, written nicely |
| `%formattedGoal%` | Your goal, written nicely |
| `%numDonations%` | How many donations you have so far |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `donordrive.donation`</small>

## Incentive

Runs when a donation on your DonorDrive page picks an incentive (a goal reward donors can choose).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Incentive description** | Only run for this incentive, typed as written on your page. Leave empty for any incentive. |
| **Minimum amount** | The smallest amount that runs this. Example: 5 ignores anything under 5. Leave 0 to run for any amount. Amounts are not converted between currencies. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Maximum amount (0 = no limit)** | The biggest amount that runs this. Leave 0 for no upper limit. Starts as: `0`. |
| **Currencies** | Only run for these currencies. Type the short codes with commas, like "USD, EUR". Leave empty for every currency. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The donor's name ("Anonymous" if hidden) |
| `%amount%` | The amount as a number, like 5 or 12.5 |
| `%currency%` | The currency code, like USD |
| `%formattedAmount%` | The amount written nicely, like "$5.00" |
| `%message%` | The message the donor wrote |
| `%recipientName%` | Who the donation was for |
| `%profileName%` | Your fundraising page name |
| `%raised%` | Total raised so far |
| `%goal%` | Your goal |
| `%formattedRaised%` | Total raised, written nicely |
| `%formattedGoal%` | Your goal, written nicely |
| `%numDonations%` | How many donations you have so far |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |
| `%incentive.description%` | The name of the incentive they picked |
| `%incentive.amount%` | What that incentive costs |

<small>Type id: `donordrive.incentive`</small>

## Profile updated

Runs when your DonorDrive page numbers change, such as the total raised. Handy to refresh a goal display.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%profileName%` | Your fundraising page name |
| `%raised%` | Total raised now |
| `%previousRaised%` | Total raised before |
| `%goal%` | Your goal |
| `%formattedRaised%` | Total raised, written nicely |
| `%numDonations%` | How many donations you have |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `donordrive.profileUpdated`</small>
